name: Kimpton Seafire Resort
insider_take: This luxury beachfront resort sits on the pristine Seven Mile Beach, one of the Caribbean's most coveted stretches of sand, where crystal-clear waters meet world-class hospitality in the heart of Grand Cayman's hotel district.
whats_special: Kimpton Seafire is the only luxury resort directly on Seven Mile Beach's most exclusive section, featuring stunning ocean views from every room. The property boasts the island's largest resort spa and offers complimentary snorkeling gear to explore the nearby coral reefs. As Grand Cayman's newest luxury resort, it combines modern Caribbean elegance with Kimpton's signature boutique hospitality.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Ave restaurant's beachfront tables - you'll dine with your toes in the sand while watching the sun melt into the Caribbean horizon, a view that's consistently ranked among the world's best.
dont_miss: The resort's infinity pools overlooking Seven Mile Beach, and take advantage of the complimentary kayaks to paddle to nearby Stingray Sandbar. The on-site AVEDA spa offers treatments in oceanfront cabanas, and the property's prime location puts you walking distance from Grand Cayman's best dining and the famous Camana Bay shopping district.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Seven Mile Beach
Kimpton's signature boutique hospitality with personalized service
Multiple dining venues featuring Caribbean and international cuisine
Full-service spa and state-of-the-art fitness facilities
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Cayman Island resorts
Hurricane season considerations during summer months
